property.name: headerTitle
property.label: Header Title
property.description: Header title for the file list.

property.name: enableFileUpload
property.label: Enable File Upload
property.description: If set to true, displays the 'Add File' button next to the search bar and the upload drop zone when empty. If false, hides the upload UI.

property.name: enableDeleteFile
property.label: Enable Delete File
property.description: If set to true, displays the file deletion button. If false, hides the delete UI.

property.name: enableFileFilter
property.label: Enable File Filter
property.description: If set to true, displays the filter button (Created Date / Created By) next to the search bar. If false, hides the filter UI.

property.name: enableRelatedRecordMove
property.label: Enable Related Record Move
property.description: If set to true, displays the record move button. If false, hides the move UI.

property.name: isMessageChannelOpen
property.label: Is Message Channel Open
property.description: If set to true, enables Lightning Message Channel communication. If false, disables it.

property.name: parentObjectApiName
property.label: Parent Object API Name
property.description: API name of the parent object used for hierarchical queries.

property.name: relatedObjectApiName
property.label: Related Object API Name
property.description: API name of the target object to which files are linked.

property.name: relatedToParentField
property.label: Related To Parent Field
property.description: API name of the reference field on the related object targeting the parent object (e.g., Account__c).

property.name: firstField
property.label: First Field
property.description: Primary field for hierarchy query conditions (Optional, e.g., ParentId).

property.name: operator
property.label: Operator
property.description: Operator for hierarchy conditions (Optional, AND or OR).

property.name: secondField
property.label: Second Field
property.description: Secondary field for hierarchy query conditions (Optional, e.g., Parent.ParentId).

property.name: exceptField
property.label: Except Field
property.description: API name of the Boolean field to exclude from ContentVersion query conditions.

property.name: gridOption
property.label: Grid Option
property.description: Default number of grid columns (2, 4, or 8). Defaults to 4 if left blank.

property.name: pageSize
property.label: Page Size
property.description: Number of items per page. Defaults to 40 if empty or less than 1.

property.name: fileLookbackMonths
property.label: File Lookback Months
property.description: File search lookback period limit (in months). Configure on high-volume pages to prevent exceeding the 50,000 SOQL row limit. Selecting 'All' queries without date restrictions.
